name: Glass voice memo
oneLiner: a voice recorder on a glass pane: a red playhead sweeps and the waveform springs up bar by bar while the timer runs, the live transcript writes itself underneath, a marker sweeps the key phrase, then stop is pressed and a green Saved chip lands
say: when the speaker talks about recording a quick voice note or the AI transcribing them ('I just talk into my phone', 'it writes down everything I say'): the wave runs while they talk, the marker lands on the phrase they stress
